tagline: KEPLER RING-0 // LOCKDOWN // ONE WAY OUT
hint_menu: Up/Down to choose, A to confirm
c_move: Left stick / WASD: move. Push lightly to walk quietly.
c_look: Right stick / J and L: turn the camera.
c_use: A / E: use terminals, levers, keycards, logs and the pod.
c_sneak: ZL / C: sneak (drones notice you later).
c_goal: Restore the reactor, crack the bridge lockdown and reach the escape pod.
c_drones: Stay out of the drones' light. Cyan: patrol. Amber: suspicious. Red: hunting.
obj_hangar: Find a keycard for the hangar bulkhead
obj_hangar2: Open the bulkhead and leave the hangar
obj_reactor: Reroute power to the reactor at the terminal
obj_reactor2: Power is back: take the east door
obj_bridge: Enter the lockdown code at the bridge terminal
obj_bridge2: Lockdown lifted: get to the escape bay
obj_escape: Reach the escape pod before the bay vents
log_read: Log {0} of 4: the code digit is {1}
term_power_help: Rotate the conduits so the feed reaches the core.
term_code_help: Four digits. The crew left them in their logs.
term_keys: D-pad: move   A: select   B: close
ending_line: Kepler station falls away behind the pod.
